title: Farmer Collaboration Fund: guidance and webinars available

content.text: The Farmer Collaboration Fund (FCF) is designed to support practical, locally led collaboration that helps farmers and land managers work together to build more sustainable, productive and resilient farming businesses.
The £30 million fund has been shaped through extensive engagement with farmers, land managers, facilitators and organisations from across the sector.

Through workshops and discussions held around the country, we heard about the opportunities collaboration can create. They also highlighted the practical challenges of getting groups off the ground and sustaining momentum once they're established.
The first funding round opens from 1 September.
Applications will close on 30 September. Successful applicants are expected to be notified in early November.
Individual farmers, land managers and group facilitators cannot apply for the FCF, but we will publish details of successful delivery partners.
We’ve published guidance for FCF on GOV.UK. This will be finalised later in August, but it should help you plan applications early.
We’ve scheduled 2 webinars designed to support you as you apply.
Tuesday 25 August, 10 am until midday Join our first webinar to learn more about the grant, the guidance and the eligibility criteria.
Wednesday 9 September, 2:30pm to 3pm Join our second webinar for a walkthrough of the application portal and how to apply.
We'll record each webinar and add the recordings to this post, so you can watch them back if you're unable to attend live.
For a notification whenever we publish a new post, please subscribe to the Farming Blog.
